name: Clams
overview: The sample verses referencing ships in Matthew 8:23, Mark 4:35-36, and Luke 8:22 highlight moments when Jesus and His disciples embarked on a journey across the lake. Although clams themselves are not directly mentioned, these passages situate the presence of marine life and the natural world within the context of Christ's ministry. This setting reminds believers of God's sovereign control over creation as Jesus calmly leads His followers through the waters, underscoring His authority and care even in uncertain circumstances.
